<function name="PlayerSpawnSENT" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>Called when a player attempts to spawn an Entity from the Q menu.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player who attempted to spawn the entity.</arg>
		<arg name="class" type="string">Class name of the entity the player tried to spawn.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Should the player be able to spawn the entity or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Stops non-admins from spawning entities.</description>
	<code>
function GM:PlayerSpawnSENT( ply, class )
	if not ply:IsAdmin() then
		return false
	end
end
	</code>

</example>
